title: SliConfiguration
description: Configuration schema for S-li (Shell Line Interface) Terminal Prompt.

activeTheme.description: Name of the active theme (e.g. sunset, cyberpunk, nord, tokyo-night, sakura, dracula, matrix).

symbolStyle.description: Style of segment separators and default branch/venv symbols.

customUserName.description: Custom display username for the first segment. If empty, falls back to the system username.

privacyMode.description: Whether privacy masking mode is enabled to hide usernames and paths.

showVenv.description: Whether to detect and display active Python virtual environments (venv, conda, etc.).

showGit.description: Whether to display real-time Git branch and dirty status.

showTime.description: Whether to display the time segment.

timeIcon.description: Icon or emoji displayed in the time segment.

pythonIcon.description: Icon or symbol displayed for Python virtual environments.

gitIcon.description: Icon or symbol displayed for Git branches.

symbols.description: Symbol configurations for each style preset.
